scope: A higher waterline that fills the desktop frame, asymmetric rear-bank plant clusters that preserve an open swim lane, four broad-leaf channel-bank groups and brighter clear-water depth; five body-and-tail colour families, individual guppy proportions, contact-grounded freshwater shrimp and surface-aware aquarium equipment

aquascape.description: Waterline raised out of the desktop frame, asymmetric grouped rear planting framing an open swim lane, compact broadleaf channel banks and brighter clear-water depth; five guppy colour families; contact-grounded shrimp and surface-aware aquarium equipment
